journal: The Journal of Physical Chemistry B
title: Surface Area Measurement of Functionalized Single-Walled Carbon Nanotubes
material_description: 4 | pretreated (acid/baked) ozonized HiPco single-walled carbon nanotubes (SWNTs): HiPco SWNTs purified by the method of Chiang et al. (ref. 24), ozonized (suspension in PFPE sparged with 9 wt% ozone in oxygen for 1 h; AFM shows cutting to short bundles), then acid/bake treated (5 wt% 1:1 nitric/sulfuric acid, 80 °C 1 h, baked 1000 °C 1 h under flowing argon); the 'pretreated ozonized sample (4) with a SSA of 1068 m2/g' used for H2 uptake; label 4 is also used for the ozonized SWNTs before the acid/bake treatment (Table 2, 381 m2/g, no H2 data)
purification_method: crude HiPco SWNTs purified as reported by Chiang et al. (ref. 24)
activation_method: acid/bake exfoliation: SWNTs mixed with 5 wt% 1:1 nitric/sulfuric acid mixture, heated at 80 °C for 1 h, transferred to a quartz tube furnace and heated rapidly to 1000 °C for 1 h under flowing argon (0.94 L/min); applied after ozonolysis
functional_groups: O (epoxide/ether-type from ozonolysis, Scheme 1; TGA C/functional group ratio 4:1 measured on 4 before the acid/bake treatment); not characterized after the 1000 °C bake
source_location: main p4 (p. 24815), Figure 5, series '4' (blue diamond markers), marker 1 of 5 in order of pressure
notes: archive: fig5_series4_markers.json; measured point of the 77 K H2 adsorption isotherm of pretreated ozonized SWNTs 4 (5 markers counted, 5 extracted; legend marker excluded). H2 measured at NREL by volumetric hydrogen capacity measurement 'at liquid nitrogen temperatures' (77 K printed in caption and text); acknowledgment thanks Drs. L. J. Simpson and M. J. Heben (NREL) for the hydrogen uptake experiments, no co-author is at NREL, so measuring_lab_id uses the first acknowledged NREL scientist. Basis not named (y axis 'H2 Adsorption (wt%)'); basis_inferred excess by the volumetric default. Degassing before H2, sample mass, H2 purity, instrument and free-volume calibration not stated. BET: multipoint N2-BET, Micromeritics ASAP 2010, samples dried at 110 °C before BET; P/P0 range not stated. Paper links the 1068 m2/g area to the H2 sample ('pretreated ozonized sample (4) with a SSA of 1068 m2/g').
